title: SeedVR2 as three plugins (3B / 7B / 7B Sharp) feeding the video upscale dropdown
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-553 - Upscalers leave the model picker, as plugins (project-refresh consolidation sweep 2026-08-13). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-553/plan.md.

Fabio, 2026-08-09. The History video Upscale tool currently offers only 'None' plus whatever .pth sits in ComfyUI's upscale_models/. Add SeedVR2 as THREE INSTALLABLE PLUGINS - SeedVR2 3B, SeedVR2 7B, SeedVR2 7B Sharp - each appearing in the dropdown once installed. Fabio owns the workflow rewrite; this card owns the app side plus the mechanism that lets a plugin contribute a dropdown entry.

DECIDED (Fabio): plugins, not a ModelDef. A weight that only upscales and generates nothing has no business in the model picker. MPI-507 moves NVIDIA PiD onto the same mechanism for the IMAGE upscale tool - build the mechanism here, reuse it there.

ENGINE: NOTHING TO BUMP. SeedVR2 is native in ComfyUI since PR #14424 (merged 2026-07-10, first shipped in v0.28.0). Our pin is v0.31.0 (bumped by 89ac23ae; an earlier note here said 0.30.0). Verified live on the engine at :48188, which already registers SeedVR2Preprocess, SeedVR2Conditioning, SeedVR2PostProcessing, SeedVR2TemporalChunk and SeedVR2TemporalMerge from comfy_extras.nodes_seedvr. Do NOT wire numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler - CONFIRMED BY BAKE-OFF 2026-08-15, not merely assumed: at matched chunk size core resolves ~50% more detail (3.86 vs 2.57), is faster, and OOMs LATER; BlockSwap does not fix the OOM because the activations are the bottleneck, not the weights. See brief 2f-ter. Licence Apache-2.0, no territory bar.

WEIGHTS (full table in brief.md, source Comfy-Org/SeedVR2, mirror to R2): seedvr2_3b_fp8_e4m3fn 3.39GB, seedvr2_7b_fp8_e4m3fn 8.24GB, seedvr2_7b_sharp_fp8_e4m3fn 8.24GB, plus ONE shared mandatory VAE seedvr2_ema_vae_fp16 0.50GB that all three list. First install 3.89GB / 8.74GB / 8.74GB; all three 20.37GB. fp16 doubles the download for an unmeasured delta, int8_convrot is LARGER than fp8, and mxfp8/nvfp4 are Blackwell-class so they cannot be a default. 3B is the video default (32 blocks, best quality/speed and temporal consistency at a usable chunk size); 7B is the hero-shot option (36 blocks, wider, slower); Sharp is an aggression dial that over-sharpens clean sources. Do NOT default the dropdown to 7B or Sharp.

THE REUSABLE HALF is the mechanism: PluginDef.operation is singular today and three plugins share videoUpscale, so a plugin needs a data field declaring which tool dropdown it feeds, its label and its injector value; the dropdown reads install state via getPluginDepStatus() and shows an install affordance instead of failing at run time; values get a plugin: prefix so they cannot collide with a .pth filename; coerceSettings() drops a stale value whose weight is gone. Build the entry source kind-aware (video|image) from the start so MPI-507 needs no refactor. FREE ALREADY: the Model Library renders plugins with search/install/uninstall keyed by pluginDepKey (MpiModelManager.js ~1044-1166) and routes/downloadManager.js:363 gives plugin deps GC protection.

WHY NOT engineAsset: videoUpscale is a UNIVERSAL workflow and universal deps install WITH THE ENGINE, so engineAsset would push 20GB onto every user at engine install. image-describer is the precedent - a 4.88GB encoder behind the universal imageDescribe op, with neither engineAsset nor bakedOnPod. Settle the remote/Pod half before coding: an engineAsset is baked into the Pod image, a plugin dep is not.

SEEDVR2 NEEDS NO PROMPT AND NO DENOISE - answered against the node signatures on :48188, not inferred. SeedVR2Conditioning builds BOTH positive and negative conditioning from a VAE latent (inputs: model MODEL + vae_conditioning LATENT); there is no text input, no CLIP input, and no text encoder anywhere in the weight set. Its only knobs are chunking_mode (ship 'auto' - it predicts the largest chunk that fits free VRAM, so frames_per_chunk stays unexposed along with its 4n+1 trap), temporal_overlap (default 0, Hann-crossfaded at merge) and color_correction_method on SeedVR2PostProcessing (ship 'lab', documented as most faithful). So a SeedVR2 entry contributes ZERO extra controls.

THAT MAKES THE CONTROL MECHANISM A PAIR, NOT A SPECIAL CASE. Fabio decided PiD gets a text input + denoise in the toolbar when selected (MPI-507), and SeedVR2 declares none. Build per-entry extra controls as a declared list on the dropdown entry, never an if(isPid) branch - both consumers exist on day one. Reuse the denoise control from PromptBoxControls.js.

RESOLUTIONS: the existing radio stands; Fabio adds the missing resolutions workflow-side so all four (1.5 / 2K / 3K / 4K) resolve. Flag before touching labels: they read as MULTIPLIERS today (x1.5 x2 x3 x4) and that is true for the .pth path and for SeedVR2, but PiD's are ABSOLUTE targets - four buttons, two meanings.

CORRECTION + THREE ANSWERS, 2026-08-09. (1) PRECISION IS int8_convrot, NOT fp8 - Fabio's call, and it is what all three of ComfyUI's own shipped SeedVR2 templates load. The reason is hardware reach, not size: fp8_e4m3fn is only native from Ada (RTX 40xx) up, while int8 also runs fast on Ampere, and Vision still ships to 30-series cards. Revised sizes: 3b 3.46GB, 7b 8.33GB, 7b_sharp 8.33GB, plus the shared mandatory VAE seedvr2_ema_vae_fp16 0.50GB (Fabio: 'we will also need the VAE'). First install 3.96/8.83/8.83GB, all three 20.62GB. (2) SEEDVR2 DOES IMAGES AND VIDEO - comfyui-workflow-templates ships utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_image, utility_seedvr2_7b_int8_upscale_image and utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_video, so its entries belong in BOTH dropdowns. Note there is NO 7B video template, so bench that path before promising it. (3) THE REFERENCE GRAPH is now in brief.md 2b, read off the shipped templates: ResizeImageMaskNode -> SeedVR2Preprocess -> VAEEncodeTiled -> SeedVR2Conditioning -> plain KSampler at steps 1 / cfg 1.0 / euler / simple / denoise 1.0 -> VAEDecodeTiled -> SeedVR2PostProcessing -> JoinImageWithAlpha, with the video path adding GetVideoComponents, Video Slice, CreateVideo, SeedVR2TemporalChunk (chunking_mode 'auto', confirming we do not expose frames_per_chunk) and SeedVR2TemporalMerge. Templates set color_correction_method 'none' even though the node default is 'lab' - bench it, do not assume.

THE 1K/2K/3K/4K RELABEL IS NATIVE. Fabio's plan is to swap the radio's labels when SeedVR2 or PiD is selected. ResizeImageMaskNode is core and its resize_type includes 'scale longer dimension' taking an absolute longer_size INT, so the four buttons map to 1024/2048/3072/4096 with no multiplier arithmetic and the same absolute meaning PiD already has. That retires the earlier 'four buttons, two meanings' warning - only the .pth path stays a multiplier.

CORRECTION 2026-08-09: SEEDVR2 IS NATIVELY A MULTIPLIER. Fabio: 'SeedVR2 actually works with a multiplier. It's only PiD that doesn't.' Correct - the shipped templates use ResizeImageMaskNode in 'scale by multiplier' mode (4.0 image, 2.0 video) and SeedVR2 has no trained input or output size. So .pth and SeedVR2 are both multipliers and only PiD is absolute. An earlier note in this card implied SeedVR2 needed the absolute mode; it does not.

ONE HARD REASON TO CONSIDER ABSOLUTE ANYWAY: the multiplier input is a FLOAT capped at max 8.0 (verified in the node schema on :48188). If the radio says 4K and the app converts to a multiplier, any source under 512px on its longest edge needs more than 8x and falls out of range - a 360px clip to 4K wants 11.4x, and the History workspace is full of small generated clips. 'scale longer dimension' takes an INT up to 16384 with no ceiling. Either switch mode or clamp knowingly; do not discover the cap in the wild.

WORKFLOW COUNT SETTLED 2026-08-09: SEEDVR2 NEEDS TWO FILES, NOT SIX. Fabio is exporting four separate workflows for PiD (MPI-507), but that decision does NOT carry over. PiD's four paths differ in three literals and are VAE-locked to different architectures; SeedVR2's three variants differ in exactly one literal - unet_name - and share the single seedvr2_ema_vae_fp16 VAE, which is why the official 3B and 7B image templates are node-for-node identical. So: seedvr2_image.json + seedvr2_video.json, with unet_name injected from the selected plugin. That is safe against the folder-listing COMBO validation problem for the same reason four PiD files are - only the installed weight is ever named in the dispatched graph. The plugin entry therefore carries its workflow file AND the unet_name to inject.

THE CHUNKING TRAP - MEASURED, 2026-08-09, AND IT CORRECTS THIS CARD. Fabio's first real run (678x1214, 81 frames, 2x, 3B int8, 16GB card) came out badly degraded with every widget matching the official template. Cause from comfyui.prev.log: 'SeedVR2TemporalChunk auto: free=14.81GiB, 3.31Mpx -> frames_per_chunk=5 (t_pixel=81)'. auto split 81 frames into ~17 chunks of FIVE pixel frames, and the template ships temporal_overlap=0, which SeedVR2TemporalMerge documents as 'plain concatenation' - so a model whose whole value is temporal context saw 5 frames at a time, hard-butted together. An earlier note in this card called auto 'the VRAM problem solved with no UI'; it prevents the OOM and silently pays for it in quality.

THE FIX IS ONE CONSTANT, NOT A NODE. The sizing math is budget = free - 10.7GiB flat reserve, chunk_latent_max = int(budget / (0.55 * mpx)), frames_per_chunk = min(4*(chunk_latent_max-1)+1, t_pixel) - reproduced exactly against the log. temporal_overlap is then clamped by min(temporal_overlap, chunk_latent - 1) with no warning, and it counts LATENT frames while frames_per_chunk counts PIXEL frames, so at 2x an overlap of 4 silently becomes 1. THAT CLAMP IS THE GENERALISATION: pass a generous constant (8) and it resolves to the maximum the chunk allows on every machine and every resolution. No MpiNode, no loop-node pack, no UI. Shipping 0 is the defect.

TWO STRUCTURAL FACTS FOR THE TOOL. (1) Chunking is UNAVOIDABLE at useful resolutions - running these 81 frames in one pass needs <=0.356 Mpx (~445x798), below the 0.82 Mpx SOURCE, so no upscale factor reaches it. Design to chunk well, not to avoid chunking. (2) The outcome is dominated by the user's GPU because of the flat 10.7GiB reserve: the same clip on a 24GB card gets frames_per_chunk 21 at 2x instead of 5. On 16GB the factor->chunk table is 2.0->5, 1.5->13, 1.25->17, 1.0->33. That swing is precisely why the tool must pick the operating point and never expose it. Pending Fabio's 1.5x + overlap 8 run: where the quality floor sits, and therefore whether the app must CAP the requested factor before dispatch using the same formula. Also noted: MpiLoadVideo has no trim, so the template's 'trim -> upscale segments -> merge' advice and a single-chunk control run are both unavailable to us.

NODE CHOICE SETTLED 2026-08-15 - CORE WINS, PACK REJECTED. The numz pack was installed and measured, not judged on reputation. Matched-chunk control (both at 33 frames): core 3.86 detail / 386s vs pack 2.57 / 446s. BlockSwap escalated 0 -> 16 -> 32 + swap_io_components on the whole-clip run bought only 1.6 GiB and still OOMed 1.46 GiB short - the activations scale with frames x resolution (the paper's adaptive window attention), so no amount of weight-swapping reaches them. The pack also OOMs EARLIER than core (49 vs 69 frames) and ships no int8. Clone left disabled at G:/ComfyUi/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/seedvr2_videoupscaler.disabled. MPI-557 unblocked.

AND THE SHIPPED CHUNK CONSTANT IS WRONG: a 17/25/33/57/69/81 sweep puts the quality peak at frames_per_chunk = 33, not the 57 the workflow ships (3.86 vs 3.46, and a far flatter decay - ratio 0.97 vs 0.70). Quality falls off on BOTH sides, so it is a real optimum. Neither path tiles SPATIALLY - both chunk temporally only. Still gated on the --lowvram re-measure before the constant reaches the app. Brief 2j.

PRODUCT VERDICT PENDING - MEASURED 2026-08-16, AND IT MAY END THIS CARD. Three independent findings, all against shipping the VIDEO path. (1) SeedVR2 SHARPENS rather than reconstructs: radial-FFT gain against a fixed lanczos baseline gives top/mid 0.57 at 1.5x and 0.43 at 2x (a sharpener's profile - a reconstructor holds gain at the top of the band), with an h264 re-encode control at 1.06 ruling out the codec. A prediction that a higher factor would force reconstruction was made and FAILED - it got worse, not better. Note it is still an order of magnitude beyond a .pth sharpener (SIAX measures mid 1.23 / top 1.10, near-identical to lanczos), so 'no better than SIAX' is NOT the finding. (2) NO SEMANTIC PRIOR, structurally - one sampling step, cfg 1.0, no text encoder anywhere in the weight set, so it restores local texture statistics with no object model. That is why it deforms eyes (Fabio: 'the iris is almost square') and invents blotches on clean skin. No widget fixes this. (3) THE 16 GB CEILING: 2x on a ~1 Mpx source collapses frames_per_chunk to 13 (33 OOMs), and 3x OOMs even at the fpc=5 floor - against a documented minimum of 5 frames for temporal consistency to engage. Fabio: 'if we're offering a model that can't even do 2x on a 16 GB card, then there's no point in offering it.' DECISION NEEDED: drop the video path and ship the image path only (it has no chunker and none of this applies), drop SeedVR2 entirely, or cap the factor. Two better-founded directions raised by Fabio and worth their own cards: upscale-then-interpolate (the interpolator supplies the temporal coherence the upscaler cannot), and LTX regenerative upscaling (conditioned + multi-step, so it HAS the semantic prior SeedVR2 lacks). Evidence: brief S 2k.
